profile.name: Jafsal M A
profile.headline: Senior Python Developer | Technical Lead | Data Engineering & Web Scraping
profile.summary: I build web crawling and data pipelines at scale: ~100 production spiders crawling millions of pages a day, feeding reliable, structured data to downstream analytics. 7+ years in large-scale scraping, anti-bot engineering, mobile API reverse-engineering, and distributed ingestion.

about.intro: I build web crawling and data pipelines at scale, turning messy, high-volume, multi-source data into reliable, structured feeds for downstream analytics.
specialisations: Running ~100 production Scrapy spiders that crawl millions of pages every day, deployed and monitored with Scrapyd and ScrapydWeb
Scraping dynamic, JavaScript-heavy and authenticated sites with Playwright and Selenium, backed by proxy rotation (Oxylabs, Bright Data, Proxyrack, Webshare), rate limiting and anti-bot handling
Reverse-engineering Android apps, including SSL-pinned ones, with Apktool, Burp Suite and mitmproxy to find and use internal APIs
Distributed ingestion and ETL (Apache NiFi, ArangoDB, Elasticsearch, Cassandra) with validation, schema evolution and client-format delivery (SAP XML, E4H XML)
Leading and mentoring engineering teams (currently leading 4) through code review, architecture, and delivery
about.recent: Most recently at PST.AG (Germany, remote), I've also been building agentic AI tooling — automation agents in the Hermes framework with MCP integration — alongside the core scraping/data engineering work.
about.closing: I'm always happy to connect with people working on data extraction, anti-bot systems, or distributed data infrastructure.

experience.role: Python Developer / Team Lead – Data Engineering & Web Scraping
bullets: Architected and maintained a scraping ecosystem of ~100 active production spiders crawling millions of pages daily across e-commerce, government, customs, trade and regulatory sources
Built crawlers with Scrapy, Playwright and Selenium for dynamic, JavaScript-heavy and authenticated targets, handling DOM volatility, rate limiting and anti-bot protections
Deployed, versioned and monitored spiders with Scrapyd and ScrapydWeb, and ran high-volume proxy rotation (Oxylabs, Proxyrack, Webshare) to keep crawl success rates high and blocking low

Led the Data Operations team for one year, owning the full ETL project lifecycle — crawling, transformation, and automated delivery — with outputs delivered to clients in SAP XML, E4H XML, and other structured formats
Built ingestion pipelines on Apache NiFi, ArangoDB and Elasticsearch to process high-volume multi-source feeds with fault tolerance and schema evolution support
Implemented automated validation and scenario-based verification to catch data anomalies before they reached client deliverables
Led a team of 4 engineers, conducting code reviews, mentoring, and spearheading internal tooling and performance optimization POCs
Joined the team building automation agents on the Hermes framework as the company moved into agentic AI, integrating MCP and Mattermost for operational communication
